author: J.Agardh, 1851

note.en: A fine, banded red tuft of the Ceramium group recorded at Punta Cahuita, Portete and Piuta Point near Limón on herbarium specimens.
note.es: Un mechón rojo fino y con bandas del grupo Ceramium registrado en ejemplares de herbario de Punta Cahuita, Portete y Punta Piuta, cerca de Limón.

evidence: GBIF herbarium specimens: Punta Cahuita (1972), Bahía de Portete (1945) and Piuta Point (1930)

sources.t: GBIF herbarium specimen records inside the region box (Gandoca to Limón)

recWhy: Record: GBIF herbarium specimens: Punta Cahuita (1972), Bahía de Portete (1945) and Piuta Point (1930).
